source.title: Investigations on Noise Cancellation and Linearity Improvement in Low Power LNAs and Receivers (I. Das, PhD thesis, IIT Guwahati, 2021), Chapter 4: low-power partial noise-canceling complementary common-gate LNA
source.figure: Fig. 4.3(a) (fully differential CCG LNA: stacked nMOS/pMOS common-gate pairs M1n,p / M2n,p, capacitor cross-coupling Cc/Rc, loads RL, output combining Co, buffer-input load CL) and its values table Fig. 4.3(b) (PDF p. 82); test setup Fig. 4.9 (PDF p. 89)
source.inputs: source/ (thesis PDF, schematic figure, test-setup figure, metrics_sizing.xlsx, operating_conditions.xlsx, pvt_corners.xlsx; see source/ORIGIN.txt)
source.technology_check: Thesis: TSMC 180 nm 1P6M CMOS, 1.5 V (PDF p. 89). Netlist: gpdk180 nmos1/pmos1 (same node; 1.5 V < 1.98 V rating). No mismatch.
modifications: None to final.scs. Its undeclared symbol CL (CLp/CLn, the output-buffer input capacitance, thesis p. 59) is fixed by dut_parameters at 200 fF (owner answer DS2a).

VSS.provenance: rule G3: ground pin without a family role driven by a 0 V source

Vbn.provenance: paper: design rule (v), PDF p. 88: Vbn = Vdd/2 + VGS,opt with VGS,opt ~ 540 mV (PDF p. 87) -> 1.29 V at 1.5 V. The low-noise-mode value is not given numerically (Fig. 4.7 only); a sizing variable (D14), this value is the curator's reference check only; reference_candidate.json now uses Vbn 1.5 V (see reference_audit_2026_10_26)

Vbp.provenance: paper: design rule (v), PDF p. 88: Vbp = Vdd/2 - VGS,opt -> 0.21 V at 1.5 V; sizing variable (D14), curator reference check only; reference_candidate.json now uses Vbp 0.0 V

CL.provenance: owner answer DS2a: CL (output-buffer input capacitance, undeclared in final.scs) fixed at 200 fF (test load)

op_check.note: All four common-gate devices are meant to operate in saturation (thesis Sec. 4.2); no exclusions.

known_issues: Fully differential DUT: measured with the lna_diff_* recipes (recipes/lna_ext.py): ideal balun from a single-ended 100-ohm port (50 ohm per side, the thesis's TCM2-33X+ 1:2 baluns, PDF p. 89), ideal 1-uF input DC blocks (vip/vin are self-biased at the nMOS/pMOS current balance), outputs open apart from CL (the thesis's high-impedance common-drain buffers, de-embedded) with noiseless 1-Gohm DC returns (vop/von reach the circuit only through Co/CL).
Low-noise mode only (owner answer DS1b): 800 uA from 1.5 V (1.2 mW). The thesis gives the bias of this mode only graphically (Fig. 4.7); Vbn/Vbp are sizing variables.
All targets are measured values (Table 4.1, PDF p. 92; text PDF p. 89-91); the thesis gives simulated curves (Fig. 4.10) but no simulated numbers.
S22 and the stability factor K were measured with the output buffers and are not covered (owner answer DS4a).
